messages.ko: 오늘 너무너무 과분한사랑을 한꺼번에 받은기분이야!! 프롬에 보내준말들도 다 읽었어 너무 고마워ㅜㅜ 내 10대마지막을 가장 행복한사람으로 만들어줘서 너무 고마워~~ 오늘 맛있는것도 많이 먹었고 멤버들과 감독님들의 깜짝 서프라이즈도 있었고 리허설중에 마지막곡을 하는데 노래가 안나오고 생일축하 노래가 나오는거야!! 이건 나중에 영상이 공개되려나..? 아무튼! 진짜 행복했어 글에서도 느껴지지!! 그중에서도 웨이브가 많이많이 축하해줘서 내가 정말 과분한 사랑을 받고있었구나… 짐작은했지만 나 하나를 이렇게 많은사람들이 좋아해주는구나 다시한번 감동받았어 올해에는 해외스케줄이라 생일 당일에 웨이브들 많이 못봐서 너무 아쉽지만 내일 그래도 콘서트있으니까 즐겁게해볼게ㅎㅎ 마카오는 이제막 12시 지났다ㅠㅠ 아쉽 내년에도 같이하장!!! 꼭
messages.en: Today I felt like I received very, very overwhelming love all at once!! I read all the messages you sent on Fromm too. Thank you so much. ㅜㅜ Thank you so much for making the last year of my teens the happiest. I ate lots of delicious food today, and the members and directors even prepared a surprise for me. During rehearsal, when we got to the last song, instead of our song playing, the Happy Birthday song started playing!! I wonder if that video will be released later..? Anyway! I was really happy. You can feel it through this message too, right!! More than anything, because so many WAVs wished me a happy birthday, I realized once again just how much love I'm receiving... I had guessed it before, but seeing that so many people love someone like me really touched me again. It's a shame that I couldn't meet many WAVs on my actual birthday because of my overseas schedule this year, but there's still a concert tomorrow, so I'll have lots of fun. ㅎㅎ It just passed midnight in Macau. ㅠㅠ It's a little sad. Let's celebrate together again next year!!! Promise.
I got so excited that I ended up rambling.
Just take in the feeling.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Fighting for tomorrow's concert too.
The stage too.
It's going to be super cool.
But you know...
They say birthdays are supposed to last a whole week.
It's not over yet~~
Keep wishing me happy birthday for a whole week. ㅎㅎ
Don't you hate how fast time passes?
Then let's just keep living in August 1st together.
ㅎㅎ
We'll just stay trapped there forever.
This birthday itself felt like a gift.
I love sightseeing abroad.
I got to sightsee.
I slept well.
I got to perform on my favorite stage.
I got to see the WAVs I love the most.
It's so nice.
And your new data plan just came in too.
Heol, I splurged a little, so I have unlimited data now.
Back in middle school...
I was always running out of data.
Then on my birthday my data would reset.
I'd even get a happy birthday text from my carrier.
A girl who even gets birthday wishes from a big company.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ

messages.ko: 작년에도 이 얘기했던 거 알아? ㅋㅋㅋ크 진짜 한결같고 귀엽네
messages.en: You know you told this exact same story last year? ㅋㅋㅋ You're really consistent and cute.
Oh, did I? ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Somewhere out there...
It's still August 1st.
So it's not over yet!!!
My mom, dad, and older brother...
Had a birthday party without me. ㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
They made a cake and seaweed soup.
And we blew out the candles over a video call.
Even that made me happy. ㅎ
It was so touching.
The members had rehearsal today and were busy too.
So I thought they probably wouldn't be able to celebrate with me.
But they surprised me.
I was genuinely shocked.
I heard Binnie gave you a hair mist as a present!!!
All the members...
Ended up revealing the birthday gifts they gave me. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I heard Nakyoung gave you a mango cake.
That's right. ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㅋ
In the group chat...
The first person to wish me a happy birthday...
Was Chaewon.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Because...
We were together.

messages.ko: 니엔이 빙수 줬다는데 맛있게 먹었겠넹 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
messages.en: I heard Nien bought you bingsu. Bet it was delicious. ㅋㅋㅋㅋ
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ They're really revealing everything. ㅋㄹㅋㄹ
The first person to message me privately...
Was Seoah.
That little one...
Gave me a power bank as a gift.
Because I'm always running around with no battery left.
Haha.
How did she know?
Such a thoughtful gift...
I'm at 37% right now.
And I've already used up the power bank too.
I have to make it last until tomorrow...
Isn't it kind of thrilling when your battery is low?
Huh? ㅋㅋㅋ Not for me.
I really must be loved. ㅠㅠ
I'm happy.
Anyway, thank you for celebrating with me.
Thank youuu.
I haranghae you so, so much.

messages.ko: 앞으로도 열심히 하는! 좋은 모습만 보여주는! 본업을 사랑하는 멋진하연이다 되겠습니다!
messages.en: From now on too, I'll keep working hard! I'll only show you my best side! I'll become an even cooler Hayeon who truly loves what she does!

Let's do our best tomorrow too.

Today and tomorrow too~~
